title: Venue logos – stacked
slide_intent: Show how a family of marks can share lettering while allowing distinguishing details to carry each venue’s identity.
strategic_value: The six venues can read as part of Sheffield Museums while each underline gives visitors a detail particular to the site.
demonstration: Six stacked marks share tall lettering and a line device. The underline changes from one venue to the next in a two-row comparison.
practical_value: Use the stacked master for the correct venue and retain the distinctive underline that belongs with its name.

content_islands.name: Family explanation
content_islands.spec: Set the page heading and narrow explanatory column at left. Describe the shared typeface and the variation in underlines.

content_islands.name: Six stacked masters
content_islands.spec: Arrange all marks in two rows of three. Keep clear space between specimens so their name breaks and underline shapes can be compared.
